    • preVisitSub

      default void preVisitSub(NamespaceVisitor.Element sub, int index, boolean isLast)
      Right before visiting the given sub NamespaceVisitor.Element. The sub element may be a child of an INodeDirectory or a snapshot in DirectorySnapshottableFeature.
      Parameters:
      sub - the element to be visited.
      index - the index of the sub element.
      isLast - is the sub element the last element?

      isLast - is the sub element the last element?
